block_thesis: S3 shoulder/injection-bearish backdrop, BUT the block is a SHORT-COVERING RALLY and I read the flow, not the fundamentals default. Aggressor share is sub-0.50 (sell) all block, yet the regime rallies = sell being ABSORBED = covering-up (structure.covering_absorption_directional_tell). COT is extreme-short and WORSENING to near-record (2.83->0.94 1y pctile, chg_wow -10k..-12k) = peak covering fuel. The strict big-print accumulation arm stays DORMANT (big_print_b never >=0.55), so the covering-absorption tell - not the accumulation print stack - carries the up-lean. My days: 0512 covering-UP (0511 net +763 absorption); 0513 shallow give-back DOWN (0512 net -2586 delivered sell, Wed re-check = no flip but down capped); 0519 covering-snap UP (thin 0518 sell into near-record short).

days.archetype: core_giveback_near_flat (D-1 delivered-sell; Wednesday mid-block re-check, no turn stack yet)
days.reasoning: S3 shoulder, weather-authority OFF (near-window max 4.23 gw << 16.4; mod_cool vs_normal +1.19; CDD 3.51). Contango/injection bearish backdrop. Wednesday = where a locked block thesis dies, so I RUN the mid-block right-the-ship re-check. D-1 (0512 Tue) tape was a genuine DELIVERED-DOWN session: session_b 0.454, session_signed_flow NET -2586 with a heavy mid-phase SELL (-2559), big_print_b 0.446 (sell-leaning) - this sell was NOT absorbed on net (covering-absorption tell does NOT fire here; it is delivery, the give-back leg of the covering rally). Turn stack for an UP flip: COT extreme+worsening leg fires (mm_net -107,489, 2.83 pctile), but the buy-absorption leg is ABSENT (0 of last ~5 big_print_b >=0.55) and 0512 itself printed delivered-sell -> the stack has NOT built, I do NOT flip to up. But C's flaw is chain-default-DOWN, so I do NOT extend a full chain-down either: this is a shallow give-back inside a covering rally with an extreme-short COT capping downside. Near-flat slight-down: p50 -200, honest-under-claim, up-tail fattened by covering risk. Genuine bimodal (give-back-down vs alternation-up).

days.archetype: core_covering_snap_up (thin D-1 sell into a NEAR-RECORD short; bid-lean book; seller exhaustion)
days.reasoning: S3 shoulder, weather-authority OFF (near-window max HDD 2.10 gw; CDD building to 9.16 = early cooling, mildly supportive; forecast_vs_normal +0.08 near-normal). Contango/injection backdrop bearish, but this is where the covering arm is STRONGEST. COT at 0519 is NEAR-RECORD short and accelerating: mm_net -120,065, 0.94 1y pctile (vs 2.83 prior), chg_wow -12,576 - the crowd is maximally short into a covering rally = peak squeeze fuel. D-1 (0518 Mon) tape was a THIN, sell-aggressor session: session_b 0.386 (strong sell aggression) but on collapsing volume (21,671 trades, ~half the block's earlier sessions) and only mild net (-872); big_print_b 0.395 (sell-leaning), yet quote_bid_share 0.528 (resting BID lean underneath). Thin exhausted sell + bid-lean book + near-record short + covering regime = crowded-short vulnerability, prime covering-snap setup. The literal buy-absorption print leg is still absent (0 of last ~5 >=0.55), so this is NOT the strict accumulation arm; it is the covering-absorption block read at its strongest COT extreme. I lean COVERING-UP, thin so modest: p50 +350. Genuinely BIMODAL vs a continued thin sell-grind down - both components emitted.
